source.title: Changes in the WCA Board of Directors (September 2020)
source.content:
With the term of Board Member Chris Wright coming to an end, an anonymous election took place on September 1st, 2020. The election was conducted according to the [WCA Motion: Election of Directors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2019.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf).

The Board received the applications of:

- Callum Goodyear
- Saransh Grover

We are happy to announce that the election was successful and that both **Callum Goodyear** and **Saransh Grover** were elected members of the WCA Board of Directors.

We want to thank Chris for all the things he has done for the WCA. We wish him all the best in his future activities!

These changes have become effective immediately.

Callum’s and Saransh’s applications can be viewed [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/11Gm-I8gC7naevA27AkFuBz8vZ8XqXOVR).

translation.title: WCA 董事会成员变动（2020 年 9 月）
translation.content:
Chris Wright 的董事任期即将结束，因此 WCA 于 2020 年 9 月 1 日举行了不记名选举。选举依照《[WCA 决议：董事选举](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2019.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf)》进行。

董事会收到以下人员的申请：

- Callum Goodyear
- Saransh Grover

我们很高兴宣布，选举顺利完成，**Callum Goodyear** 和 **Saransh Grover** 均当选为 WCA 董事会成员。

感谢 Chris 为 WCA 所做的一切，祝他今后一切顺利！

以上变动立即生效。

Callum 和 Saransh 的申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/11Gm-I8gC7naevA27AkFuBz8vZ8XqXOVR)查看。
